jobs.description: Set next to the picturesque Vondelpark, in the heart of the city, the 396-room Amsterdam Marriott is celebrated for its proximity to significant landmarks such as the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum, exclusive shopping, vibrant nightlife and high-end restaurants. The hotel also features 11 flexible meeting and event spaces with natural daylight, including our Grand Ballroom and studios.Guests can enjoy premium dining at Midtown Grill, one of Amsterdam's top steak restaurants, as well as Bar TWLV, our cosmopolitan bar offering globally inspired dishes, creative cocktails and a day-to-night atmosphere What are my responsibilities?We are looking for an enthusiastic and service minded F&B Service Host for our newly renovated Midtown Grill restaurant, our Sorel's Bar and Lounge and our M Club Lounge. You are the contact person for our guests during the service periods, by being highly visible in the public areas. Besides that, you help your colleagues with In-room Dining and Mini Bar services. Are you passionate about delivering excellent service to ensure our guests a brilliant stay? What makes you the perfect fit?You enjoy working in an international and dynamic environment and are passionate about delivering excellent service to ensure our guests experience a brilliant evening. You are knowledgeable about meat and wines and are passionate about giving personal service and making sure our guests have an unforgettable evening. To be eligible for this position you:• have relevant work experience• speak Dutch and/or English fluently• are friendly and have an open posture• can deliver a high level of service• are stress resistant• are able and flexible to work different shifts What does my contract look like?• Start as soon as possible• Full-time contract of 38 hours per week.• One month probation tim
